item.title: dotnet: Modernize your .NET apps for Windows Arm64 with GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Microsoft announced guidance for using GitHub Copilot’s upgrade agent to modernize .NET apps for Windows Arm64, covering blocker identification, migration planning, and code changes. The post is a .NET Blog entry focused on the upgrade workflow.

  • Source: .NET
